_status: CONFIRMED (names and effects); Science token wording is single-source

tokens.name: Architecture
tokens.text: When you construct a Stage of your Wonder, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Propaganda
tokens.text: When you take a Red card with 1 or 2 Horn icons, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Urbanism
tokens.text: When you take a Wood or Clay Grey card, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Crafts
tokens.text: When you take a Papyrus or Glass Grey card, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Jewellery
tokens.text: When you take a Stone Grey card or a Yellow card, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Science
tokens.text: When you take a Green card, choose 1 extra card from the 3 available and place it in front of you.

tokens.name: Engineering
tokens.text: When you construct a Stage of your Wonder, you can use any Resources, without adhering to the 'identical' or 'different' restrictions.

tokens.name: Economy
tokens.text: 1 of your Yellow cards is worth 2 Coins instead of just one.

tokens.name: Tactics
tokens.text: Add 2 Shields to your total Shields.

tokens.name: Strategy
tokens.text: At the end of the game, gain 1 Victory point per Military Victory token you have.

tokens.name: Education
tokens.text: At the end of the game, gain 2 Victory points per Progress token you have (including this one).

tokens.name: Decor
tokens.text: At the end of the game, gain 4 Victory points if your Wonder is still under construction or 6 Victory points if it is entirely constructed.

tokens.name: Politics
tokens.text: At the end of the game, gain 1 Victory point per Cat icon on your Blue cards.

tokens.name: Culture
tokens.text: There are 2 copies of this token. At the end of the game, gain 4 Victory points if you have 1 token or 12 Victory points if you have both.
